This neuron keys on word-internal subword fragments of rare/unusual names and terms (brand names, transliterations, all-caps chemical names) rather than on any semantic content — it activates positively on pieces like "Lin" in "Linen", "OD" in "SODIUM", "el" in "maelstrom", and is strongly suppressed on similar mid-name pieces such as "agn" in "Lagnado", "uel" in "Beguelin", "ach" in "Kapach".

L6·N7768unmasked layer
